s0_title
BillShield: private medical bill audits, with hybrid A.I. on Firebase A.I. Logic.
s1_problem

Medical bills are often wrong, and they are the most identity-dense document most people own. Pasting one into a cloud chatbot hands over your name, birth date, and insurance I.D. BillShield finds the overcharges without that data leaving the browser. Here, Firebase A.I. Logic is connected, and App Check reports a valid token.
s2_hybrid

Raw bill text only ever goes to Gemini Nano, through Firebase A.I. Logic in only-on-device mode. Not prefer-on-device, which could fall back to the cloud with raw identifiers. A deterministic leak gate rescans every outbound byte. Only redacted findings reach the letter step, which prefers Gemini Nano and falls back to cloud Gemini.
s3_audit

Let's load a synthetic sample bill, then click Audit privately. The pipeline runs a rules scan, the on-device scrub, a seven-rule billing audit, and the leak gate. This recording browser has no Gemini Nano, so the on-device step is honestly marked skipped.
s4_findings
The audit is deterministic, so the model never decides what is wrong. Here: a line math error, a duplicate I.V. charge, and an advisory price outlier. About five hundred seventy dollars to dispute.
s5_receipt

Every name and I.D. becomes a placeholder; the real values stay inside the tab. The privacy receipt shows the exact outbound payload, its size and hash, the passed leak gate, and the App Check token. The letter was drafted by cloud Gemini through Firebase A.I. Logic.
s6_letter
A fact checker confirms every amount and billing code traces to a finding. Only then is the real name re-inserted, locally.
s7_spanish

BillShield now speaks Spanish and Japanese. The interface follows your browser language, or you can switch it here. Findings are localized on the device from structured facts, so the cloud never translates English text. Audit again, and the Spanish letter passes the same leak gate and fact check.
s8_japanese
The same in Japanese. Dollar amounts and billing codes stay identical in every language, so the checker can trace each one.
s9_offline
BillShield is an installable web app. Now the network is switched off. The page still loads, and the rules scan, leak gate, audit, and a template letter all run offline. Nothing leaves the device.
s10_outro
BillShield, by Green Robin Labs. Try it at billshield-kappa dot vercel dot app. The code is open source on GitHub.
